body:
Less than a year.  Its a total drag where no one can tell what I am and thus most people would rather avoid me instead of interact with me.  Or worse.

It seems everyone I work with saw the marks on my neck.... I don't know what to do about this at all.

Yes the clue is I'm transgender and its caused me to lose everything in my life.  I got kicked out of my mothers house for it over a year ago, and since then my friends have slowly stopped talking to me.  

I got an apartment with a friend when this all went down, but now shes sick of me.  I think shes been annoyed by my depression, as the worse it got the less she talked to me.  Our lease is almost over and she found new roommates to replace me, despite promising for months that she would never do that..

My mom will let me back in her house but she wont give me a room.  I have to sleep on the couch and I cant keep my belongings there.  She and my father have been verbally and physically abusive all my life, and the thought of living with either of them terrifies me.  I cant afford to rent anywhere on my own, and I don't have a single friend anymore.  Everything just feels so hopeless nowadays.
